description: Mutes individual channels of a polyphonic signal, from buttons or from gates, with a master mute over all sixteen

params.text: Each press mutes and unmutes that numbered channel of the signal
Each press mutes and unmutes every channel at once
SOFT ramps the level whenever a mute changes, so audio does not click; HARD switches instantly

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to be muted
A polyphonic gate; a channel above 2V here mutes the matching channel of the signal and takes that channel's button out of use
A gate above 2V here mutes every channel, and takes the master mute button out of use for as long as a cable is patched

outputs.text: The signal with its muted channels silenced, carrying as many channels as the input

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
